title: Cities of Refuge and Levitical Cities

date.label: Undated Joshua refuge and Levitical city narrative
date.note: Biblical narrative chronology is not independently established as an absolute BCE date.

claims.claim: Joshua 20 designates exactly six refuge cities, three each bank (Joshua 20:7–8)
Refuge provisions apply to unintentionally killed persons (Joshua 20:1–6)
Levites have cities although no broad tribal land allotment (Joshua 21:1–8; 13:14)
Deuteronomy 19 establishes refuge-city provisions without naming all six towns; Joshua 20:7–8 names the six cities. (Deuteronomy 19:1–13)

connections.note: Numbers 35:6–34 gives the most detailed preceding legislation on unintentional homicide and refuge.
Previous account specifically names three eastern refuge cities.
Deuteronomy 19:1–13 sets out the legal conditions and access-road prescriptions for refuge.
The 1 Chronicles 6 list is related but not identical to the Joshua 21 list, so the two lists must be collated rather than automatically harmonised.
